last_debrief: STORY SO FAR: Sun 08-30, day 19, Sunday evening (19:33 IST). THE -la TAPE SHIPPED — real audio this time, 9.1 min, five verbs on-then-off, published, HA push 200. The 08-29 silence was the cloud container's missing voice credentials, not the code; on this laptop render_soak works end to end. Soak order delivered. THE HEADLINE: the -la tail went from silence to audible BY EAR and then fired COLD twice in production, inside one session. Opened by paying the idli trailer (podhum/venaam/saaptaachu seats, plus the lore that Tamil DOUBLES TO SOFTEN — podhum podhum is gentler than podhum, seri seri, vaanga vaanga). Ran a two-auntie veranda eavesdrop and he came back with every tail AND every past marker inverted — vandhaaru as 'is coming', potten as 'will make', saapdala as 'eat?', nethu ravu as 'today', aana as 'and'. EVERY STEM WAS RIGHT; only the last syllable died. Carved it as: English front-loads the news ('he DIDN'T eat'), Tamil hides it in the last unstressed syllable, so his ear relaxes exactly where the meaning lives. Re-checked cold — 'mama nethu vandhaaru, innikki varala' came back WORD PERFECT, and he built sollala's meaning unaided off a verb he owns. tail-inaudible MARKED LANDED. THE FIND OF THE NIGHT, A REFINEMENT OF THAT TAG: the tail is only audible on a stem his ear already knows COLD. varala/saapdala/sollala all landed; கேட்கல failed THREE TIMES (twice by ear, once from the mouth) and it failed the same way on 08-29 — read as 'said' both nights. So a dead tail is never fixed with more tail work; make the STEM automatic and the tail comes free. That reframes machines-heard: an unheard machine may be an unheard VERB. THE WIRE: for Andrew, கேட்கு currently IS சொல்லு. Three ear-misses read கேட்கல as 'said', then the closing fire ('tell her you will ask him') came back சொன்னேன் — the same confusion from the production side, and it predates my teach. One clause given: சொல்லு pushes words OUT, கேட்கு pulls them IN, and athai's own veranda line carries both back to back (naan ketten / avaru onnum sollala). Did NOT re-drill — carve then ambush. AMBUSH kekkuren later this week, unannounced. THREE HONEST FIRES: (1) 'mama saapdaaraa?' → saapdala, instant, built off HER verb. (2) 'unakku theriyuma?' → theriyala, instant, built off HER verb — the exact word he double-missed 24h ago with puriyala then appadi illa. chunk-not-machine MARKED LANDED: he stopped grabbing from the drawer and started building the specific no off the verb the question just used, twice, unaided, novel scenes. (3) kekkuren → sonnen, MISS, logged wrong-verb-direction (4th). MY ERROR, SAME CRIME AS 08-23 AND 08-29: I put கேட்கல in the ANSWER SLOT of an ear drill on a verb he has never owned. Owned it out loud, gave கேட்கு free, no debt. HIS DECOMPOSITION ASK, unprompted and his highest-yield move: 'does onnum decompose?' — yes, ஒண்ணு + -உம், 'even one'. The payoff: he had ALREADY decoded enakkum correctly by ear an hour earlier, so the -உம் sticker is his; it was only new welded onto a number. Gave the family — naanum, yaarum, eppavum, engayum — and -um on two things = 'and' (coffee-um tea-um). MISSION COLLECTED AND FIRED: theriyala went off LIVE in the house, first time someone asked him something he did not know. Strongest cold-fire evidence there is. HIS TESTIMONY, A CURRICULUM CORRECTION: 'Podhum was the first Tamil I ever learned, 10 years ago, it never needs teaching.' He is right AND THE LEDGER ALREADY KNEW — போதும் sits at solid/cold — yet a knock trailer commissioned it as a teach and I opened the session paying that trailer off. @build ticket: a solid/cold row must never be the payload of a trailer teach. STILL OPEN: english-word-order still uncommissioned at 12d, but recorded with a --no-commission reason this time instead of deferring silently. wrong-verb-direction now commissioned to the soak lane. TOMORROW OFFERED: Deep-Dive on the கேட்கு/சொல்லு family, pull vs push, a couple of fires riding along; low-power twin is Ear Day on tonight's new tape, no answering. TONIGHT'S MISSION: next time anyone in that house asks him a question whose answer is no, take THEIR verb and hand it back with the tail on it.

soak_order.focus: கேட்கு vs சொல்லு — THE PULL/PUSH PAIR, AND THE STEM UNDER THE TAIL. He read கேட்கல as 'said' three times tonight and then produced சொன்னேன் when he needed கேட்குறேன்: for him these two verbs are currently ONE verb. Do NOT permute the -ல tail here — he owns that tail now (வரல, சாப்படல, சொல்லல all landed cold by ear today). Permute the VERB PAIR against each other in matched frames, nothing else moving: நான் கேட்டேன் / நான் சொன்னேன், அவரு கேட்குறாரு / அவரு சொல்றாரு, அவரு கேட்கல / அவரு சொல்லல. Direction is the whole payload — கேட்கு pulls words in, சொல்லு pushes them out. Ride அவரு and நான் so the person never becomes the puzzle. Every lexical item from lexicon.json. Never name a rule.
